replies.author: Sevoo
replies.body:
At least something that can detect blatant cheaters with fly or ka or something. Don't ban them, just freeze them and staff will get a notification about a player that is frozen. That way the hacker won't be able to do anything, the staff member will be alerted and if the anti cheat is being weird the subject won't get banned, only frozen.

If the player logs out while frozen, they get a log saying he was frozen. After you log out a second time it will ban you. This is to avoid random people who got falsely frozen to not be banned when they log out if they don't read chat.
